readiness.reason: Both complete LOOP manifests, integrity/coverage checks, first official scores and saved1593-window views must be bound before contrasts.

interpretation.gain: For error rates, positive means comparator error minus cell error in percentage points. For numeric accuracy, positive means cell accuracy minus comparator accuracy.
interpretation.primary: Judge PERSON gain over historical direct baseline requires LB90>0; PERSON gain over KC-E1f requires LB90>=-0.25009; realized generation calls<=796.5; all applicable guards pass.
interpretation.targeting: Judge-vs-twin PERSON LB90>0 is required for the targeting attribution, separately from component admission.
interpretation.guards: Corpus WER gain LB90>=-0.05793; numeric accuracy gain LB90>=-0.15651; insertion-rate gain LB90>=-0.022178. Preserve all1593 windows and exact predecessor text outside accepted substitution spans with identical whitespace-token counts. Nonentity/ORG and semantic high-impact errors are descriptive, not newly added gates.
interpretation.reporting: Twin-vs-direct and twin-vs-KC-E1f are predefined reporting comparisons, not extra admission gates. Publish all five comparisons.
interpretation.weighting: Natural pooled call-cluster bootstrap is primary; inherited equal eligible-call mean is reported beside it with the same fixed draws. Sector and sample-rate groupings are descriptive. Preserve sign disagreements and guard sensitivities; do not invent a second positive-CI gate.
interpretation.scope: Full44 discovery component comparison using sealed predecessor and selection plans. No live initial-draft, online selection, superiority or final meeting-minutes claim.
interpretation.protocol_identity: Both current arms share np4/c36864/max1024 formal packets. Historical raw-audio comparator differences remain explicit. Component counts and saved window/call views are related evidence, not independent replications.
